admission.justification: The channel duty is stated across six role sources and three operations, and the delivered-text guard fails when one of its clauses is removed.

applicability: Every canonical role source or multi-role operation delivered in a capsule whose handover can name a parent.
conditions: The delivered text states the parent-routed question channel and the final-await ending for a role with a parent.
A busy or permission-prompt refusal keeps the question under 'Pending developer questions' in the report and is retried before the turn ends.
Only an unreachable parent (archived, not found, not resumable, no runtime configured, host unreachable) opens the own chat.
A relayed answer is recognized only with the three rule-5 marks and is recorded with the quoted words where the role requires a record.
exclusions: Dashboard-started and other parentless roles, which keep the own-chat sentence.
Answering a harness permission prompt, which only the developer does in the waiting chat.
The dashboard waiting mark, which this packet excludes.
statement: Each delivered parentable role instructs questions to the parent, independent work without a developer wait, pending-report recovery for busy delivery, own-chat recovery only for an unreachable parent, and recorded quoted developer answers with the receiving agent ID.
